scope.target: The exact PH1P_LOGIC_ERAM instance used by silu_shared_unit.v

overall_status.summary: The exact official encrypted PH1P functional model compiled and ran under ModelSim with its official PH1P_PHY_GSR dependency. The run confirms several functional-model observations for the exact 20x1024 SP/NOREG configuration, but it does not supply SDF timing, silicon power-up, collision guarantees, or TD mapping evidence.

public_primitive_interface.authority: Official Anlogic UG1310 guide and the clear-text header before the encrypted model payload
can_prove: legal parameter names and documented choices
that PH1P_LOGIC_ERAM represents an ERAM20K resource

encrypted_vendor_functional_model.authority: Official TD 6.2.1 sim_release PH1P sources executed by ModelSim
can_prove: observed behavior of this exact model build and parameter set
that the encrypted model was successfully decrypted, elaborated, and executed
that PH1P_PHY_GSR is a required simulation companion top
cannot_prove: silicon behavior where the public manual leaves behavior undefined

handwritten_behavior_model.restriction: Its synchronous read and write implementation is not Anlogic evidence and is not used to justify any confirmed vendor behavior.

actual_silu_binding.effective_port_use: Single active A port. B is disabled even though its clock is connected. The primitive reset is never asserted by the current SiLU instance.

enables.ocea: A-port output-register enable, active high, documented as relevant only when an output register is present
enables.oceb: B-port output-register/read enable, active high, documented as relevant only when an output register is present

writes.byte_enable_zero: BYTE_A and BYTE_B are 1 when BYTE_ENABLE is 0; the configuration disables byte subdivision

output_mode.manual_constraint: When the output has no register, RESETMODE_A/B must be ASYNC, not SYNC

manual_header_discrepancy.resolution: The exact vendor model header spelling was used; it compiled successfully. No semantic meaning beyond the documented ASYNC/SYNC choices is inferred.

dependency_discovery.initial_elaboration_status: failed as expected when PH1P_PHY_GSR was absent
dependency_discovery.resolution: Compiled the official same-TD-version ph1p_phy_gsr.v and elaborated PH1P_PHY_GSR as a companion top. No local replacement was created.

commands.command: vsim -c -lib work PH1P_PHY_GSR tb_ph1p_vendor_behavior -l simulate_vendor_final.log -do run -all; quit -f

compile_gsr.log reports Compiling module PH1P_PHY_GSR from the exact official source command
The only PH1P_LOGIC_ERAM definition compiled into the isolated work library was the official encrypted vendor source

warnings.text: Out-of-bounds INIT_FILE part-select warnings during optimization
warnings.impact: The model still elaborated and the test completed. These warnings prevent a warning-free claim and should be raised with Anlogic if this model is used for regression signoff.

observed_exact_configuration_behavior.evidence_level: official encrypted functional-model observation without SDF

startup.observation: PH1P_PHY_GSR is required. The final test waited through a 61 ns guard before functional accesses.
startup.hardware_contract: unknown; the helper is a simulation model, not a board startup measurement

read_latency.observation: With address and CEA stable before a rising CLKA edge, NOREG data was correct at the test point 1 ns after that same edge. Example: address 7 read at the 95 ns edge produced 0x12345 at 96 ns.
read_latency.cycle_statement: The address is sampled on rising CLKA and data is observable during the cycle immediately following that edge. A synchronous consumer can safely treat it as a one-edge read and sample on the next rising edge, subject to real implementation timing.

cea_stall.observation: With CEA low for rising edges at 125 ns and 135 ns, DOA held 0x12345 while ADDRA changed.
cea_stall.contract_limit: No hidden multi-request queue was exercised or inferred.

ocea_with_noreg.observation: Reads updated DOA while OCEA was 0; setting OCEA to 1 did not add a visible stage. The guide states OCEA is relevant only when an output register is present.

write_and_mask.observation: With BYTE_ENABLE=0, BEA=0, CEA=1, and WEA=1, writes to addresses 7, 8, and 9 were retained and read back.
write_and_mask.interpretation: For this exact no-byte-subdivision configuration the model does not require BEA high for a whole-word write.
write_and_mask.not_proven: Other BYTE_ENABLE or BEA configurations were not tested.

write_mode_normal.observation: On the address-9 write edge, DOA retained the previous value 0x2abcd; the following read edge produced new value 0x54321.
write_mode_normal.restriction: UG1310 names NORMAL but does not define collision return data at edge precision. Upper-level scheduling must not rely on this observed old-output behavior as a silicon guarantee.

reset.observation: Asserting RSTA asynchronously between clock edges drove DOA to 0 within the 1 ns observation interval. After release, address 8 still read 0x2abcd on the first read edge, so array contents were retained in this run.
reset.current_silu_relevance: The current instance ties RSTA low, so SiLU reset does not invoke primitive reset. SiLU must continue invalidating transactions/table state at wrapper level.

initialization.observation: Address 10, never written by the test, returned 0 after GSR while INIT_FILE and FILL_ALL were NONE.
initialization.hardware_contract: unknown; UG1310 does not state that silicon memory powers up to zero. The production design must fully runtime-load all 1024 words before inference.

b_port.reason: The actual SiLU configuration disables CEB and WEB, so B-port data behavior is outside the active contract.

ecc.reason: ECC encode/decode and error injection are disabled in the actual configuration.

physical_mapping.reason_not_run: This audit was authorized for read-only evidence checking and isolated vendor simulation, not a TD synthesis/map run. No existing report was found that maps this exact SiLU RTL hash and named instance.
physical_mapping.unrelated_existing_evidence: An existing video-baseline report states total ERAM=40, but it is not a build containing this exact SiLU instance and cannot prove its mapping.
